summary: Y-API is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (~20 models across OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, Qwen, MiniMax, Tencent, Xiaomi, StepFun prefixes). Its /daily-key page issues one shared key per day funded by a $20 pool, refilled at 00:05 UTC; the pool is shared across all users and can drain early, and keys die at the next rotation. Sign-in via GitHub or Google is required. Personal accounts separately get $1 starter credit, no card required.
claim_steps: Sign in to Y-API with GitHub or Google
Open https://y-api.bestvirtualgoods.com/daily-key and copy today's shared key and the Base URL shown
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at the Base URL with the key (OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_KEY)
